en.name: Cinnamon rolls, baked
en.summary: Baked cinnamon rolls keep 1–3 days at room temperature, covered, and 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Rolls topped with cream-cheese icing are a different matter: that icing is a perishable dairy food and belongs in the fridge.
en.pantry: 1–3 days covered at room temperature, and the shorter end if they are heavily iced or the kitchen is warm. A cinnamon roll is an enriched dough with a sugar-and-butter filling — plenty of fat to keep the crumb soft, but also a moist, sugary interior that mould is happy with. Keep them in a tub or under a cloth rather than sealed in plastic, which raises the humidity inside and brings mould forward. A plain glacé-iced roll is fine on the counter; one finished with cream cheese or a custard filling is not.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for cinnamon rolls, and for a plain one the fridge is the wrong place anyway: chilling speeds up staling, because starch retrogradation runs fastest just above freezing, so a cold roll goes dry and dense. Refrigerate only what the topping requires — cream-cheese icing is a perishable dairy food and must be kept at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Warm a chilled roll briefly before eating; gentle heat re-gelatinises the starch and undoes most of the staling, though it does nothing about mould.
en.freezer: 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Cool them completely, wrap individually with the air excluded, and freeze on the day they are baked rather than after they have already started to dry. Freeze them un-iced where you can and ice them after reheating — icing freezes into something wet and patchy. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe well beyond the window; the limit is drying, ice crystals and freezer burn.
en.thawing: Thaw wrapped at room temperature for an hour or two, then warm briefly in a low oven, or heat straight from frozen in a covered dish. A roll thawed in the fridge and still cold may be refrozen with some quality loss; one thawed on a warm counter should not be.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould spots, which start in the damp, sugary centre of the swirl.
A sour or fermented smell from rolls sealed in plastic while still warm.
A dry, dense crumb that no longer pulls apart in strands.
A sour smell from cream-cheese icing, which decides the matter on its own.
tips: Cool completely before covering; trapped steam brings mould forward.
Freeze un-iced and ice after reheating.
Wrap individually so you can take one at a time.
Cream-cheese-topped rolls go in the fridge regardless of what the base timeline says.

faq.q: How long do cinnamon rolls keep?
faq.a: 1–3 days covered at room temperature, or 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Do cinnamon rolls need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Plain and glacé-iced ones do not, and the fridge stales them faster. Rolls topped with cream-cheese icing must be refrigerated, because the icing is a perishable dairy food.
Yes, 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze them un-iced on the day they are baked, wrapped individually, and ice them after reheating.

zh.name: 肉桂捲
zh.summary: 烤好的肉桂捲蓋好放室溫可放 1～3 天，−18 °C 冷凍是 3 個月。但上面淋奶油乳酪糖霜的那種是另一回事：那層糖霜是會壞的乳製品，該放冷藏。
zh.pantry: 蓋好放室溫 1～3 天；糖霜厚或廚房溫暖的話，請往短的那端抓。肉桂捲是加了油脂與蛋奶的豐腴麵團，中間捲著糖與奶油——油脂讓組織柔軟，但那個又濕又甜的內層也是黴菌很喜歡的地方。請裝進保鮮盒或蓋一塊布，不要密封在塑膠袋裡，那會把袋內濕度拉高、讓霉提早報到。只淋簡單糖霜的可以放檯面；用奶油乳酪或卡士達收尾的不行。
zh.fridge: 肉桂捲沒有公布的冷藏期限，而對原味的來說，冰箱本來就是錯的地方：低溫會加速老化，因為澱粉回凝在略高於冰點時最快，所以冰過的肉桂捲會變乾變密。只有配料要求時才冷藏——奶油乳酪糖霜是會壞的乳製品，必須放在 4 °C 以下。冰過的要吃之前稍微加熱一下；溫和的熱能讓澱粉重新糊化，把大部分老化抵消掉，但對霉一樣沒有用。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 3 個月品質最好。完全放涼、一顆一顆包好、擠出空氣，而且要在出爐當天就冷凍，不要等它已經開始變乾。可以的話冷凍不淋糖霜的版本，回熱之後再淋——糖霜冷凍後會變得又濕又花。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個期限仍然安全；限制它的是變乾、冰晶和凍燒。
zh.thawing: 包著在室溫放一兩個小時解凍，再用低溫烤箱稍微回溫；或直接從冷凍加蓋加熱。在冷藏解凍、還是冰的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；在溫暖檯面上解凍過的就不要再凍。
spoilage: 長出絨毛狀霉點，通常從捲心那個又濕又甜的地方開始。
還熱著就密封的那批聞起來發酸、有發酵味。
組織變乾變密，撕不出一圈一圈的層次。
奶油乳酪糖霜聞起來發酸——光這一點就足以判定。
tips: 完全放涼再蓋起來；困住的蒸氣會讓霉提早出現。
冷凍不淋糖霜的，回熱之後再淋。
一顆一顆分開包，要吃幾顆拿幾顆。
有奶油乳酪糖霜的，不管基本期限寫什麼都要放冷藏。

faq.a: 蓋好放室溫 1～3 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。
原味或只淋簡單糖霜的不用，而且冷藏會讓它更快變乾。淋奶油乳酪糖霜的一定要冷藏，因為糖霜是會壞的乳製品。
可以，−18 °C 下 3 個月。出爐當天、不淋糖霜、一顆顆包好冷凍，回熱之後再淋糖霜。
